Again a double 400m hurdle win from gave us a good start and we didn't drop a single point over 1500 and 3000 metres as we turned out the super quartet of Helen Maskrey, Nina Mills, Morag Andrew and Nikki Haines.

At the half-way stage, running through the woods at the foot of the hill, it was Morag Andrew leading our contingent but close behind were Helen Maskrey and Martina Ryan and a little further back again was Nikki Haines making her debut in Belgrave colours.

Good forward running came from from Nikki Haines and Jacinta Moore, and modern pentathlete Kate Houston surprised a few with her 37th but with a few absences through injury and maternity, it was 5th place overall for the Bels.
